title: S23: Backup correctness gaps: schema gate trusts manifest, torn snapshot, reset destroys live package

description: The restore schema gate trusts the manifest over the actual records (needs a min-over-records check); the snapshot zips a directory that may be concurrently written (manifest taskCount and the real record count can disagree); and a reset destroys the LIVE backup package via prune, leaving recovery dependent on a <=24-hour-old zip. Severity: Medium. Wave/Plan: Wave 2, plan 2b backup-restore-correctness. Sweep: sync machinery.
